decisions.summary: Tooling only, DIRECT route, no perf bookends, no map review occasion
decisions.why: Spec Assumptions: map review checks untouched; no engine change.

decisions.summary: Units as check:subject with word-normalized fingerprints per unit
decisions.why: Implements FR-004's definition of CHANGED and FR-006's content the check read.

decisions.summary: CHANGED = normalized text present nowhere in the record at the base; FR-004 table applied mechanically; intro-check on research pages only; base read in one ls-tree + cat-file batch over research/questions/ (1,404 files) and only the write-ups the delta touched
decisions.why: Restates FR-004 and the move/merge and drawing-page Edge Cases. Reading only touched write-ups narrows nothing: a write-up the delta did not touch cannot have changed visible text. Counts re-run 2026-10-02 (ls): 1,404 question files, 2,126 write-ups - both reproduce.

decisions.summary:
Intro is

, first block after heading and comments, at most one, no mark, no styling; may name the class its cited body or drawing page reaches; shape test
decisions.why: FR-002 and the intro Edge Case, now in the spec's own words.

decisions.summary: intro-check pinned Opus at medium effort, omitClaudeMd, Read+Grep, tier table and ledger lint
decisions.why: FR-001: pinned tier, launches without auto-loaded files.

decisions.summary: INTRO-OK / INTRO-FIX for INTRO-PRESENT-OK / INTRO-PRESENT-FIX; NEEDS-INTRO names the class the cited body or drawing page reaches, four classes
decisions.why: Naming only; the four rulings and the class list match FR-001 (round-1 D4 finding resolved).

decisions.summary: Bundle holds the research page's whole visible text (comments stripped), the drawing page's visible text, and modal Name/Label; notes not copied
decisions.why: Carries the cited body FR-001's INTRO-FIX half must read; notes are not needed to judge the page's words against each other (round-1 finding resolved).

decisions.summary: _record_owed.py over pure _record_units.py; make record-owed [Q=]; --unanswered; --between for SC-002; reuses _entry_owed/_translation_owed
record-checked BUNDLE= records the fingerprints the bundle's MANIFEST captured, in the pushing clone's git dir
decisions.why: FR-006 and the spec's decision that answer records live in the pushing clone.

decisions.summary: Without BUNDLE=, any check may be recorded with a REASON of two words or more written to the bypass log; a fix that applies findings is owed again (second round) or discharged by such a reason
decisions.why: FR-007's stated-reason discharge to the bypass log; FR-008's two-round cap (round-1 D6 finding resolved).

decisions.summary: CHECK=source-reader Q= NOTES= records the tree's fingerprint of notes whose source the reader read, without a bundle or a reason
decisions.why: FR-006 records 'the content the check read'; source-reader reads the source before the note exists, so no bundle can carry the note - the literal rule is physically impossible here. Limited to source-reader on named notes, it does not reopen an unlogged discharge for other checks.

decisions.summary: entry-gate.sh becomes the record gate on both routes; RECORD_CHECKS_OK discharges all; ENTRY_DRIFT_OK kept for entry-drift units; a prose rewrite still clears an entry-drift unit
decisions.why: FR-007 folds entry-drift's refusal and reason into one gate; FR-004 keeps entry-drift 'as today'.

decisions.summary: _entry_owed.moved_anchors compares the body with comments and the intro removed
decisions.why: FR-004 last row.

decisions.summary: check-bundle refuses a not-owed FOR= bundle (NOT_OWED_OK reason, logged), owed-notes default for quote-check, MANIFEST owed lines, dispatch hook refusing a check the MANIFEST does not owe (CHECK_NOT_OWED_OK)
decisions.why: FR-005 and US2; enforcement of the requested behavior.

decisions.summary: record-style exempt from the not-owed refusal
decisions.why: Spec Assumptions: record-style stays a sweep check owed by a declared sweep (feature 292).

decisions.summary: KEY= bundles refused unless source-applicability is owed on the key (write-up) or a source-reader unit is owed on a note citing it (WHOLE=1); NOT_OWED_OK covers a source's numbers reaching a map
decisions.why: FR-004/FR-005 applied to KEY= bundles; the map-bound occasion is the spec's Assumption, served by a stated reason (round-1 findings resolved).

decisions.summary: A WHOLE=1 read declared NEW="<the claim>" for a claim not yet in the record is built, recorded in the guard log and MANIFEST
decisions.why: A named, recorded stated reason under FR-005's override, now held to the two-words floor FR-005 sets (review-2 aside applied).

decisions.summary: Backfill in about ten intro-check dispatches of about 24 questions under NOT_OWED_OK='feature 311 backfill'; rulings in backfill.md; intros written from the drawing page and make canon; each answered in at most two rounds
decisions.why: FR-008, the backfill Edge Case and the Assumptions; batch size is design.

decisions.summary: Doctrine files and the descriptions AND contract bodies of quote-check, record-format, source-applicability, source-reader, translation-check say 'run on the units make record-owed names' and record with make record-checked
decisions.why: FR-010 (round-1 finding resolved; T09 matches). entry-drift's contract already names its script.

decisions.summary: Red-first tests per FR-004 row and Edge Case, gate tests for SC-004, SC-005 seeded three a leg in backfill-size batches, SC-002 tabulated in research.md, make done / record CHECK=1 / hooks-test
Constitution check rows; XII now says each intro may name the class its cited body or drawing page reaches (four classes) and adds no historical claim
decisions.why: Not a decision of its own; XII now matches D3/D4 and FR-001 (review-2 aside applied).
